attchmntText: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of extract of unaudited financial results of the company for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Global Helicorp Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a net loss after tax of Rs. 16.18 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, compared to a net loss of Rs. 155.87 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, the net loss after tax was Rs. 1184.81 lakhs. Total income from operations stood at Rs. 13189.33 lakhs for the quarter. The company noted an exceptional item of Rs. 156.39 lakhs related to new labour codes for the year ended 31 March 2026. It also disclosed a customs duty dispute of Rs. 7616.84 lakhs, for which no provision was made as an appeal is pending. The company stated it remains a going concern despite negative net worth of Rs. 5202.16 lakhs as of 30 September 2026. Separately, CFM Asset Reconstruction Private Limited took symbolic possession of mortgaged properties from three borrowers, including Sri Vigneshwara Silver Works, Killadi Raju, and Sri Sai Durga Home Foods, for outstanding debts.

attchmntText: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of extract of unaudited financial results of Tieramet Limited for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Bhagyanagar India Limited intimates that Tieramet Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on 13th November 2026. Advertisements appeared in Business Standard and TeluguPrabha on 14th November 2026. Tieramet Limited reports total income from operations of 1,034.63 Crore and net profit after tax of 30.54 Crore for the quarter. For the half year, total income from operations was 1,738.14 Crore and net profit after tax was 50.64 Crore. Earnings per share were 0.69 for the quarter and 1.75 for the half year. The equity shares allotted under the Composite Scheme of Arrangement are yet to be listed. Listing applications with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited are under process. UGRO Capital Limited proposes relocating a branch in Peddapalli with effect from 14th December 2026. Inference Platforms Limited reports a net profit after tax of 72.37 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange about appointment of Chief Financial Officer of the Company.
voiceSummary: Bhagyanagar India Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 19.23 lakhs for the quarter and 33.88 lakhs for the half year. The Board appointed Mr. Rahul Surana as Chief Financial Officer effective November 13, 2026. The Board approved a Postal Ballot Notice for member approval regarding the regularization of Shri Mangilal Narender Surana as a Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and the sale or joint development of land in Uppal with M/s. Om Sree Builders and Developers LLP. Mrs. Sravanthi Gadiyaram was appointed as the Scrutinizer for the e-voting process. The Postal Ballot is scheduled to commence on November 17, 2026, and conclude on December 16, 2026. The results are subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Board Meeting of Tieramet Limited
voiceSummary: Tieramet Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 5063.95 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 173814.34 lakhs. The board also considered the Tieramet Employee Stock Option Scheme 2026, which is subject to shareholder approval by way of a special resolution. The financial results were reviewed by statutory auditors Luharuka and Associates. The company was formed following a composite scheme of arrangement effective 1 October 2026. Tieramet Limited has applied for listing on the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited, with approval awaited.

attchmntText: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Others
voiceSummary: Bhagyanagar India Limited intimates that ICRA Limited has assigned credit ratings to the bank facilities of its subsidiary, Tieramet Limited. The total rated amount is Rs. 654 Crore. The assigned rating is ICRA A- with a Stable outlook. The facilities include long-term fund-based bank facilities. The rating was assigned on November 11, 2026. Tieramet Limited is yet to list its equity shares. Listing applications with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited are under process. The company does not currently have access to stock exchange listing portals. The rating letter is enclosed with the intimation.
